title: visemes.json
description: Per-frame mouth and brow channels for one dialogue line. Rig-agnostic on purpose: in M1 these drive shape keys on a stub head, and in M4 the same channel names drive FLAME jaw pose and expression coefficients, so nothing downstream changes when the real face lands.

profile.description: Set by the style pack. graphic holds each viseme flat and snaps between them; smooth co-articulates. §8 — realistic co-articulation looks wrong on a flat painted face.

channels.description: The eight in pipeline.validate.VISEME_CHANNELS, which are the shape keys the rig carries. A file may omit channels it never drives.
